nonBlockingIssues.description: test_positional_query_dispatches_single_shot uses single quoted arg instead of separate words. An additional test with separate words would improve confidence.
test_execute_flag_enables_auto_execute has overly permissive assertion checking both keyword and positional arg passing.
Two-pass parsing doesn't support flags-before-subcommand ordering (e.g., 'vox --model foo listen').
Exception tests use try/except pattern instead of idiomatic pytest.raises().
Error path tests verify None return but don't assert stderr output messages.
No explicit delegation test for module-level query_llm() wrapper.
Module-level wrappers create new OllamaProvider on every call — micro-inefficiency for repeated calls.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add to Architecture Notes: 'CLI main() uses two-pass parsing: first pass detects subcommands from _SUBCOMMANDS frozenset, second pass separates flags from query words. This means flags must come BEFORE the subcommand, not after.'
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: cli-test-suite worker refactored cli.py main() with two-pass parsing (lines 467-510) to fix argparse positional query conflict on Python 3.12+. AGENTS.md currently only says 'argparse with subcommands'.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add to Testing Conventions: 'Use pytest.raises() for exception assertions, not try/except/assert False patterns.'
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: provider-abstraction tests at test_provider.py:33 use try/except instead of pytest.raises(). Currently AGENTS.md specifies unittest.mock for mocking but not exception testing idiom.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update tdd-worker skill to mention: 'When testing existing code, you may discover pre-existing bugs that need fixing. Fixing these bugs is acceptable during the GREEN phase when the bug is in scope and blocks your tests from validating correct behavior.'
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: cli-test-suite worker found and fixed an argparse bug during GREEN phase. Current skill lists pre-existing bugs as a reason to return to orchestrator, but fixing in-feature was the correct action here.
